name: jenkins_agent
description: Analyzes Jenkins CI build logs, pipeline stages, test reports, and git commits to diagnose pipeline failures and validate remediation builds.

skills.name: investigate_incident
skills.description: Performs root-cause analysis on a failed Jenkins build incident and writes findings to the Blackboard.

skills.name: reinvestigate_incident
skills.description: Re-investigates a new validation build after a fix attempt (attempt > 0). Fetches new build logs, compares error signatures, checks test counts, and runs flakiness re-analysis. Writes versioned evidence to the Blackboard.

attempt.description: Reinvestigation attempt number (must be > 0). Caps at REINVESTIGATION_MAX_ATTEMPTS (default 5).

previous_failure_summary.description: Summary of what failed in the previous attempt, injected as context so the LLM does not repeat the same hypothesis.

new_build_url.description: Full Jenkins build URL of the new validation build triggered for the fix PR. Both multibranch (/job/app/job/main/42/) and view-based PR (/job/app/view/change-requests/job/PR-7/5/) URL formats are accepted.

blackboard_ref.description: Reference to the versioned Blackboard entry written at attempt+1.
